about: ERW, What a battery saves a customer (/battery/customer): the cases of the replication (session 7504, chain 304). The page reads no table, so a case is what a reader would type. The rates of a tariff case are the publisher's, as its document prints them, with the document, its effective date and the time it was read. The customer and the battery of a case are not data: they are the case, chosen inside the tariff's class, and said as such. Method: docs/methods/battery_customer.md.
read_by: session 7504, with the User-Agent 'ERW research project, github.com/SamuelEnrique/erw'; each host's robots file and terms were read first (the note, 'The hosts read').
